description: Declarative documentation of the current Kotlin serializers and Firestore rules, not an automatically enforced database schema or evidence of deployment, security, content, or publication approval. JSON date-time strings are portable representations; x-firestore-type identifies native Firestore Timestamp storage. See docs/firestore-schema.md for access rules, lifecycle, and known gaps.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile containing training preferences, goals, and metrics

email.description: User email address; rules validate length, not email syntax or Auth equality

photoUrl.description: User avatar photo URL; omitted when Kotlin value is null

trainingGoal.description: Primary fitness goal; rules do not restrict goal names

weeklyTargetWorkouts.description: Current rules allow 1–7; product policy requires a minimum of 2 (unfixed gap)

weightKg.description: Body weight in kilograms; omitted when Kotlin value is null

heightCm.description: Height in centimeters; omitted when Kotlin value is null

createdAt.description: Native Firestore Timestamp, serialized here as JSON date-time; supplied timestamp or serverTimestamp fallback

updatedAt.description: Native Firestore Timestamp, serialized here as JSON date-time; serverTimestamp on each profile write

WorkoutLog.title: WorkoutLog
WorkoutLog.description: User workout session history and progress log

completedAt.description: Native Firestore Timestamp, serialized here as JSON date-time; supplied timestamp or serverTimestamp fallback

createdAt.description: Native Firestore Timestamp, serialized here as JSON date-time; supplied timestamp or serverTimestamp fallback

CurriculumLessonIndex.title: CurriculumLessonIndex
CurriculumLessonIndex.description: Indexed movement curriculum lesson referencing markdown asset location

category.description: Kotlin writes TopicCategory.name; rules allow any nonempty string within the length bound, not a fixed enum

assetPath.description: Relative bundled markdown asset location; rules check length, not asset existence

LessonProgress.title: LessonProgress
LessonProgress.description: User completion status and timestamp for a curriculum lesson

userId.description: User UID who completed the lesson

completedAt.description: Native Firestore Timestamp, serialized here as JSON date-time; current repository writes serverTimestamp on each completion save

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document storing personal settings and workout targets

/users/{userId}/workout_logs/{logId}.description: Subcollection of logged workout sessions for progress tracking

/users/{userId}/lesson_progress/{lessonI.description: Subcollection of completed lessons per user for progress tracking

/curriculum_lessons/{lessonId}.description: Indexed movement curriculum lessons referencing markdown file locations
